title: test_kg_lock's workers lose log lines appending to one file on Windows
goal: The workers of test_kg_lock_main_lock_keeps_holders_apart_and_planted_unlocked_overlap record start and end without concurrent appends to one shared file (which lose lines on Windows, where append mode is a seek then a write), so all three of its cases pass on Windows run after run, the planted unlocked run still overlapping

run: import subprocess, sys; sys.exit(max(subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/tests.py", "-k", "test_kg_lock_main_lock_keeps_holders_apart_and_planted_unlocked_overlap", "-q"]).returncode for _ in range(5)))
